findings.what: The original `.max(START_DEADLINE)` was changed to `.min(START_DEADLINE)`, so the deadline is now capped at START_DEADLINE instead of floored at it. Multi-app staged starts get less time than the summed budget and the daemon's stage waits, which is the opposite of the documented 'Never under START_DEADLINE' intent, and the client can time out before the daemon.
